name: Editorial research studio
intent: A calm, evidence-led system that feels technical without resembling a dashboard.
rules: Use one dominant composition per page.
Use no more than five body bullets; prefer fewer.
Keep evidence labels next to the evidence they describe.
Use theme variants rather than arbitrary per-page colors.
Use screenshots once unless a deliberate before-and-after comparison requires repetition.
Put detailed citations and demo contingencies in speaker notes.
Avoid card grids, pills, decorative UI chrome, slogans, and unsupported claims.
